preconditions.description: The number of operations n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= i - 1 for i in range(1, n + 1) for k in [int(line.split()[0]) if line.strip() else 0])
preconditions.description: For each operation i (1-based), the number of edges k added satisfies 0 ≤ k ≤ i - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vj <= i - 1 for i in range(1, n + 1) for line in [input_lines[i - 1]] for j in range(1, int(line.split()[0]) + 1) if j <= len(line.split()) // 2)
preconditions.description: For each operation i, every vertex vj referenced in the operation satisfies 1 ≤ vj ≤ i - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= xj <= 10**9 for i in range(1, n + 1) for line in [input_lines[i - 1]] for j in range(1, int(line.split()[0]) + 1) if j <= len(line.split()) // 2)
preconditions.description: For each operation i, every weight xj satisfies -10^9 ≤ xj ≤ 10^9.
The total number of edges across all operations does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output is the sum of all edge weights in the final forest modulo 1000000007.

postconditions.expression: sum_of_weights == sum(depth(root(vj)) + xj for i in range(1, n + 1) for line in [input_lines[i - 1]] for j in range(1, int(line.split()[0]) + 1) if j <= len(line.split()) // 2)
postconditions.description: The sum of weights is computed as the sum of all edge weights added during the operations, where each edge weight is depth(root(vj)) + xj.
